capabilities: Embed HTML files in notes with native embed syntax
Embed remote web or local-network pages by address
Size embeds by width, height, auto-fit or CSS
Scroll to or extract a single element of a page
Run page JavaScript and load external stylesheets, scripts and fonts
disambiguation: Not an HTML-to-Markdown converter; it displays HTML files and pages inside notes as live pages.
extras: Documentation is an interactive demo vault shipped with each release and openable via a command; beta builds install through BRAT.
problem: Obsidian embeds notes, images and PDFs, but an HTML file in the vault can only be opened, not shown inside a note.
summary: Embeds HTML files and web pages inside notes using native ![[file.html]] syntax, with custom sizing, theme styling and working scripts.
